rule_text: Mother listens automatically.

rule_text: Mother must not schedule duplicate deliveries for the same Need.

rule_text: After the delay, Mother says “ok”.

rule_text: Dissatisfaction resets immediately to 0.

rule_text: The reset is the Child’s proof that something worked.

rule_text: The Child is not directly told which exact word worked.
evidence: Learning saves the recent stream as a group and never passes the trigger word separately to memory.

rule_text: The Child only knows that the recent words before “ok” may have worked.
evidence: The algorithm treats the latest speech window—not one identified word—as the plausible cause.

rule_text: When dissatisfaction resets, the Child saves the words spoken in that round.

rule_text: It saves up to the last 20 words.

rule_text: If fewer than 20 words were spoken, it saves all of them.

rule_text: The saved words become a plausible approach for that Need.

rule_text: A Need’s active memory is the newest successful word list for that Need.
evidence: Every success replaces activeMemoryWords with the newest learned list.

rule_text: Every successful saved list is also kept in history.
evidence: Every success appends its list to savedLists while incrementing successCount.

evidence: Normal learning never removes prior savedLists; reset behavior is separately user-controlled.

rule_text: Re-triggering the same Need uses that Need’s active memory first.
evidence: buildFallbackPlan returns own_active first when the target Need has active memory.

evidence: Browser repeated milk and visibly selected “milk own active memory”.

rule_text: Each successful round may shrink the active memory.
